title: helianthemum vulgare var. asperum
intro: Helianthemum vulgare var. asperum, commonly known as Rough Rockrose, is a plant species within the Cistaceae family. It is a flowering plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rough Rockrose include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its wound-healing and anti-infective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
